title: The market closes on Friday. Your loan doesn’t.
lede: We measured it before we built it. Every weekend the reference price feed on this chain goes silent for <num>55.7 to 80.8 hours</num>, while an around-the-clock source kept answering <num>288 times out of 288</num>. People don’t stop either: <num>29.9%</num> of SPY transfers happen on a Saturday or a Sunday.
hoursSince: hours since the reference feed last spoke
chartLabel: Timeline of one weekend. The reference equity feed updates until Friday 16:18 UTC and not again until Monday 00:00 UTC, 55.7 hours later. An around-the-clock source reports every ten minutes throughout, 288 points out of 288.
caption: One measured weekend, 28–31 August 2026, drawn to scale. Over the Labor Day weekend the same silence lasted 80.8 hours. <link>How we measured it</link>.
